title: Guardian Spirit
text: So, as the village’s reconstruction progressed, more buildings went up, and the place started to buzz with activity—and then, one day…
“Have there been sightings of a mysterious monster around here?”
“Yes, we’ve been hearing reports that some of the village children and the soldiers stationed here have spotted it here and there.”
Itsuki reports this to Father.
“Motoyasu, Gaelion, do you have any idea what this might be?”
“Was there such a rumor?”
As I tilted my head in confusion, my Rival answered as if he knew exactly what was going on.
“Oh? Is it about to be discovered?”
“Do you have any idea what it might be, Gaelion-chan?”
“I do.”
“It’s probably nothing good, is it? It really feels like they’re just using us as playthings.”
“That’s right. Do you even realize how much trouble you’ve caused us, you and Motoyasu!”
Rin and Itsuki’s trust in us is plummeting. It might be better to awaken her quickly before she starts causing a ruckus.
“It’s not Gaelion’s fault—it’s the Spear Hero’s fault.”
“You’re practically an accomplice yourself. Seriously.”
“So, is there anything going on?”
“Knowing the answer isn’t everything, you know. Anyway, Naofumi and Sadeena are heading out to investigate with the villagers.”
My rival is just giving orders on his own!
“Father, I’m under no obligation to obey!”
“In this case, it might be best to side with Gaelion by opposing Motoyasu.”
“No, how about we just run away to stay out of this?”
Ren and Itsuki are stepping in and getting in the way.
“Now, now… so you’ve singled out me and Sadeena, have you?”
“Oh my—I wonder what’s going on?”

By the way, Big Sister’s older sister has started happily rubbing her belly. Father also says she’s been drinking less. She looks very happy. She’s getting along better with my father-in-law than at any other time in this loop.
“Gaelion-chan, will this end up causing trouble for Ren and Itsuki?”
“I promise it won’t this time.”
“What do you mean, ‘this time’!?”
“Well then, let’s go check it out.”
“Father! Are you actually going to listen to what Rival says!?”
“It doesn’t seem like a bad idea, after all.”
“Speaking of the Spear Hero… aren’t you forgetting on purpose? Oh, but since you were in shock, it wouldn’t be strange if you didn’t know.”
Rival is muttering incomprehensible things under his breath. He’s saying things that are incredibly frustrating!
“Stop beating around the bush and just tell us what’s going on! It’s not right to tease people by staying silent, Rival!”
“We should definitely call him out on this! Motoyasu-san! You of all people shouldn’t be saying that!”
“That’s right, that’s right! Your explanations always come at the weirdest times, and it’s hard for us to figure things out!”
“You should get a taste of it too! It’s karma, after all!”

Ren and Itsuki are being so noisy! I think it’s about time I used the Paralyze Lance to immobilize these two and make sure Fleon-chan and Black Thunder solidify their bond—maybe I’ll even make them change outfits! Just as I let out a killing intent, my Father let out a sigh.

“Now, now… Anyway, let’s just go with the flow this time. You never know what’s going to happen in life, and it wouldn’t be any fun if we just asked Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan about everything, would it?”

“No, it’s precisely because we knew what was going to happen in advance that we’ve been able to stay on the right path and keep our composure! We’ve managed to avoid playing the fool as annoying characters!”

“Ah! I’d much rather have a life with a strategy guide than suffer terrible consequences from selfish actions! A predetermined fate revealed in advance? Bring it on! I’d rather not have any ‘awakenings’!”
“Sigh… Ren and Itsuki are getting pretty messed up… Or rather, it’s like they’ve lost the ability to believe in anything anymore…”
“They’re turning into Wild Naofumi, aren’t they?”
“I wonder about that, too…”
“As usual, the heroes are a bunch of clueless idiots…”
Just as the Panda said this with an exasperated tone, Ren and Itsuki gave a small cough, as if snapping back to their senses.
“Things have gotten even weirder since Gaelion started looping.”

Even the Assistant is lamenting. Rival, you’re steadily ruining everyone’s opinion of you! Serves you right! After a conversation along those lines, led by my Father and my Big Sister, we all set out together with the villagers to defeat the monster in question. And so… after roughly scouting the terrain around the village, we arrived near the cemetery along the coast. A mist-like substance began to hang in the air.
“It feels like something’s about to come out.”
“It’s near the villagers’ cemetery, isn’t it?”

Ren and Itsuki scanned the area while keeping a watchful eye on their surroundings. The cemetery… Suddenly, I recalled what happened after the Filolial producers’ ranch was attacked by Takt’s gang. Most likely, the ones Yuki-chan and the others defeated back then were the remnants of Filolial-sama… There are undead in this world. Ghosts and the like can also be wiped out with Magic. I’m so grateful to Yuki-chan for that. Without thinking, I find myself petting Yuki-chan’s head.
“Motoyasu-sama… I’m so happy.”

But has something like this ever happened in this place before? I get the feeling that this mist-like thing… is similar to what we see when my Big Sister or the Raph-species use Magic to create illusions…
“It looks like we’re about to run into one.”
Just as my Rival said that, ahead of us—beyond the mist—appeared a weasel-like creature formed from a bluish-white heat haze… I recognize this guy!
“Father! I recognize this monster! I saw it on Big Sister’s island in this loop!”
Upon closer inspection, it was a monster that looked like a giant weasel.
“This loop?”
“Yuki-chan, do you remember it?”
“Of course I do! It’s the monster that came out of the bushes while I was walking through the woods with Motoyasu-sama on Sadeena-san’s island!”
Yuki-chan nodded in response to my question.
“Just as Lord Motoyasu was about to attack, it made a run for it with incredible speed!”
“I won’t let it get away this time! Aiming—”
“Stop, Spear Hero!”
For some reason, my Rival stopped me right then. The weasel, constructed from a wavering, pale-blue heat haze, came to a halt just as it had before and transformed into a Tanuki.
“What on earth is this monster…”

Ignoring us as we remained on guard, the monster didn’t turn toward me, my Father, Ren, or Itsuki. Instead, it quietly turned its face toward Big Sister’s older sister, the villagers, and the village itself, then bowed its head as if in silent acknowledgment.
“What’s that…?”
“…That?”
As the villagers stood there scratching their heads, my Big Sister’s Big Sister cautiously approached the monster alongside Father. Suddenly, the fog began to clear.

With a soundless cry—more like a howl—the mysterious, ghost-like monster let out a howl and then vanished into thin air right before Father and my Big Sister’s Big Sister. And where it had vanished, a human figure appeared… in the form of a child… What on earth! There, my Big Sister appeared in a child’s form and immediately began to collapse forward.
“Watch out!”
Big Sister’s Big Sister rushed forward to catch her, and Father followed suit.
“R-Raphtalia…-chan?”
“Huh? Did that monster turn into Raphtalia-chan?”
The villagers all let out cries of surprise as they saw the unconscious Big Sister being held by her older cousin.
“She looks like someone we know.”
“I’m pretty sure her name is Raphtalia…”
“Yes, she’s supposed to be Naofumi-san’s destined partner—or rather, the girl he relied on as his right-hand woman.”
“She’s alive!?”
Paying no mind to the astonished onlookers, the older cousin hugged the Big Sister tightly and checked her breathing.
“Ah… Raphtalia-chan, you’re alive…”
Tears are streaming down Big Sister’s eyes. There’s not a trace of her usual cheerful demeanor, and even to us watching, it’s clear at a glance that she’s rejoicing from the bottom of her heart.

Amidst this exchange, Rival—for some reason—spread his arms wide and began chanting some kind of Magic. “What is she planning to do?” I wondered, when suddenly something from the surroundings gathered in her hands and crystallized.
That crystal looks familiar. If I’m not mistaken, it’s the guardian spirit—or something like that—that was sealed inside that Rafu-like monster modeled after my Big Sister in a previous loop.
“Guardian spirit retrieval complete. I’m glad I managed to save it just in time before it vanished into thin air.”
As soon as she finished speaking, Rival put the crystal away.
“Gaelion-chan, could it be…?”
“That’s right.”
In response to Father’s question, Rival gave a slight nod.
“But why…? I’m pretty sure the records said Raphtalia-chan was dead…”
“Her body wasn’t found, was it? Also, Naofumi, in the wild, it’s not uncommon for monsters to feign death. So it’s not really that strange.”

It’s what they call “playing dead,” isn’t it? Of course, there’s holding one’s breath, but in this world, there are also methods that utilize Magical Power or the soul. Takt’s homunculi, for example, can do something similar in a broad sense.
“If she can do something like that, what kind of Demi-Human is this Raphtalia?”
“By Naofumi’s standards, she’s a raccoon… but they say Rafu is a tanuki Demi-Human.”
“I see, a tanuki. So she was able to feign death—pretend to be asleep like a tanuki—to make it look like she was dead. But surely she couldn’t do anything about being sick, right?”
“Well, you can just assume that her will to live played a big part in that. You can think of it as Rifana, who wanted Rafu to live at least a little, risking her own soul to save her.”
Rival said this with a smug air, as if he’d figured it all out. Come to think of it, Big Sister’s friend had already passed away, hadn’t she?
“Still, we’ve only managed to rescue her. Naofumi, cast healing Magic on her and hurry to carry her to a place where she can rest!”
“R-right! Everyone! Let’s hurry back!”
“Yeah!”

At Father’s instruction, the villagers nodded, and we hurried back to the village to tend to Big Sister. Her older sister has been by her side the entire time, keeping a close watch on her condition. Fortunately, although Big Sister was quite weak and coughed violently from time to time, her condition improved rapidly after my Father gave her some Yggdrasil medicine.
“Mr. Gaelion, is Rifana… a villager from here?”
“Yes. She was a friend of Rafu’s—a villager who died right in front of him.”
“Yeah… Rifana was one of our own.”
The villagers nod.
“Rifana… she’s passed away too, isn’t she?”

“That’s right… To be honest, saving Rifana is impossible even for the Spear Hero who’s been looping through time—unless he loops on the very day he’s summoned, resolves the issues as he goes, and rushes to her aid immediately.”
“Is that so…”
“Normally, she’s the one the Spear Hero would save in the next loop by acting skillfully and rescuing Big Sister while helping Rafu.”
“Ah… Come to think of it, Naofumi and Sadeena had asked Motoyasu for that. I wonder if it worked out.”
That brings back memories. In the next loop, I saved Big Sister just as my Father and the others had asked. I never would have imagined she’d still be alive in this loop.
“So you knew, Gaelion?”

“I did. Actually, in the loop where Naofumi and Gaelion fell in love, I looked into it later and found out that Sadeena and Rafu had been reunited. Apparently, they met after Sadeena brought the villagers back to this land ruled by Eclair for a while.”
So that’s what happened. Back then, I was traveling with Filolial-sama for a while because of my resentment toward my Father…
“So that’s why Gaelion was so cooperative about rebuilding the village?”
“She even tried to convince my Big Sister, didn’t she?”
“That’s right. So, what do you think? It’s Gaelion’s surprise!”

My Father and my Big Sister’s older sister are smiling happily at this Rival who’s standing there with her chest puffed out! Don’t be fooled! She just needs to be honest—but this Rival is actually after my Father!
“Rival, just because Gaelion-chan’s Big Sister tried to steal my Father from me doesn’t mean it’s going to work out!”
“Oh my? Naofumi-chan. Is my Big Sister going to let Gaelion-chan steal you away?”
“No way, no way. It’s a bit roundabout, but thanks, Gaelion-chan.”
“Thank you, Gaelion-chan. I’ll invite you to a banquet next time.”
“No, that’s a bit…”
“Nooo!”
Father’s smile turned into a wry grin!
“Ha, ha ha…”
“U… u… uugh…”
Just as that was happening, I heard my Big Sister’s voice, and she slowly opened her eyes.
“Where am I…”
“Raphtalia-chan, are you awake?”
“S-Sadeena-onee-san…? Huh? I…”
As my Big Sister—who seemed confused about what had happened—tried to sit up, her Big Sister gently placed a hand on her shoulder, as if to tell her to go back to sleep.
“You don’t have to get up yet, Raphtalia-chan.”
“But… I… I’m pretty sure…”
“Yes… it was a rough time. But you’re okay now.”
“I feel so… foggy… I can’t quite remember, but I… we were… looking for the village together…”
“This is the village. We rebuilt it. So don’t worry—I’m so happy to see you too, Raphtalia.”
“I see…”
Her Big Sister gently holds her hand and strokes her cheek.
